status: registered before the first native-queue materialization
purpose: Verify an authenticated native APEX request, durable Oracle worker claim and real two-candidate execution. This is not an algorithm comparison.
selection: An eligible challenger survives only if its measured Oracle score strictly exceeds the incumbent. Ties retain the incumbent.
request: Label is metadata only. Seed, generations and materialization budget must exactly match the immutable authenticated Oracle request. Attach the fresh run to its worker claim before generating any application definition.
recovery: An expired or uncertain worker claim is never automatically requeued. A committed import attempt is never automatically retried.
limitations: One seed and one advance cannot establish evolutionary or AI superiority.
Automated task effort and timing are engineering proxies, not a human usability study.
The same classic-report and separate-page trusted mappings and fitness policy are used as in the original feasibility test.
This protocol does not enable unattended scheduling or paid provider requests.
